text.p: -- Mesirow Financial said it has initiated coverage of Tupperware Corp with a buy rating and a 12-month target price of $52 to $55 a share.
-- Tupperware shares on Wednesday were up 3/8 at 43-1/2.

-- In a recent report, Mesirow said it projects a 6.5 percent sales increase to $1.4 billion in 1996 with operating income up 11 percent to $249.5 million. It projects earnings per share of $2.70 in 1996, versus a pro forma $2.55 in 1995. It projects earnings for 1997 of $3.05 a share.

-- "We believe (Tupperware) represents a unique investment opportunity for long-term investors," Mesirow said. "The company has a global brand franchise in the Tupperware name and a sound strategy for growth through new product introductions, expansion into new and untapped markets and the ability to increase its distribution network at a relatively lower level of expense versus traditional retailers."
